text: Do not use `std::reverse`, `std::reverse_copy`, `std::ranges::reverse`, `std::ranges::reverse_copy`, or reverse iterators (`rbegin`, `rend`, `crbegin`, `crend`, `std::reverse_iterator`, `std::make_reverse_iterator`).
